communication_goal: 说明阻塞原因、确认依赖时间，并提出可继续做的工作。
image_prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE standalone finished educational scene illustration, square 1024x1024. Pure white background, clean consistent black line art, minimalist adult stick figures with circular heads, simple expressive faces and thin limbs, restrained polished programmer workplace comic aesthetic. No color, no gradients, no shading, no photographic rendering. One coherent scene, no panels. Keep all people and props in the central area approximately x=180..820 and y=220..790 on a 0..1000 canvas. Preserve generous empty white space at top (y<180), bottom (y>850), and sides for learning labels added later. Make the named learning props clearly recognizable and fully visible. Gestures should show a conversation. No speech balloons, letters, numbers, captions, logos, watermarks, readable code, or long text; simple abstract UI marks are allowed. Scene: Two adult stick-figure developers discuss a blocked task beside a simple desk. The developer on the left is seated and holds a clearly recognizable rectangular smartphone upright in one hand at chest height, away from the face and body. The screen is blank except for a small generic phone handset icon. The team lead on the right stands listening with an open hand, a small notepad at their side. Keep the whole smartphone distinct, fully visible with rounded bezel, not merged with fingers. No text or symbols representing blocked tasks, and no readable board.

coverage_review.scope: W023 的逐词编辑与底图视觉核对完成；本专题其他计划卡未制作，不声称学习效果或手机端验收。

image_review.summary: 通过：左侧开发者持手机说明阻塞，右侧负责人倾听；手机完整边框和听筒图标清晰可辨。背景任务板不作为阻塞或依赖证据，失败原因和时间预估请求由对白说明。
